guide.summary: Giving records: asset-specific status, per-field money units, donor joins and deposit reconciliation.
guide.content:
# Overflow usage

Overflow production: live nonprofit giving, donors and money.

Nonprofit purpose: Grace Church giving and deposits

Named reads minimize contact data; get_donor is the full-contact lookup. Webhook signing secrets are always removed.

## Giving records and joins

Donor ids join profiles, contributions, subscriptions and payment methods.
Campaigns and subcampaigns allocate gifts; locations identify campuses.
Resolve names to ids before editing a donor or moving money. There is no funds
endpoint: fund and sub-fund identifiers occur only in payment authorization.
A donor profile owned by a donor account cannot be edited through this API;
when reads work but its edit is denied, changing the credential does not fix it.

Tap groups contain devices and point to destinations. A tap is engagement,
not a gift; use contributions to establish giving.

## Money and final status

Read the unit per field. Values named `InCents` are cents, including deposits,
refunds, chargebacks and payment authorization. Subscription `amount` is
in dollars. Contribution and saved-method charge `amount` have no stated unit
in the public schema: establish it from a known gift before reporting a sum
or authorizing a charge. Do not assume every numeric amount uses the same unit.

A gift is final at `PAID_OUT` for `CASH`, `CONFIRMED` for manual cash or crypto,
`CONTRIBUTION_RECEIVED` or `BILLED` for stock, and `CONTRIBUTION_RECEIVED` for
DAF. A status bucket is coarser than those asset-specific states. Polling by
updated date finds later state changes; initiated date identifies when a donor gave.

## Reconcile a deposit

Find the bank payout, inspect its summary totals, then its line items.
Each line item's `referenceId` names a contribution, refund or chargeback
according to its type; contributions can also carry a `depositId`.
Keep gross, fee and net cent amounts separate and convert only for presentation.
An eligible cash gift under $1,000 is refunded with `POST /contributions/{contributionId}/initiate-refund`, which takes no body; its string acknowledgement means the refund started.
A refund request starts processing; verify the gift or refund before claiming
that funds have reached the donor. Canceling a recurring gift stops future
payments and does not refund earlier gifts.

## Reduce donor and delivery data

Giving history and donor contact details are personal data. Aggregate or join
inside code and return names, email, phone and address only when the task needs
them. Lean contribution rows carry donor identity; the full donor lookup
carries contact details. Webhook delivery logs can include delivered donor
payloads and the receiving server's response: select the status, response code
and error needed for diagnosis instead of returning those payloads wholesale.

## Conventions

- **Paging:** every tool whose output declares `page` is paged: `list_campaigns`, `list_chargebacks`, `list_contributions`, `list_deposits`, `list_donors`, `list_locations`, `list_payment_methods`, `list_refunds`, `list_subscriptions`, `overflow_api_details`, `overflow_api_read`, `overflow_api_search`. While `page.hasMore` is true, pass `page.nextCursor` back unchanged using the continuation argument its schema declares; keep the original arguments. The last page has no `nextCursor`. At execute_code's per-program call limit, return page.nextCursor and continue in the next program; don't restart.
- **Paging:** a paged `list_*` or `search_*` read takes `limit` (default 25, at most 100) and `cursor`. While `page.hasMore` is true, pass `page.nextCursor` back unchanged as `cursor`; the last page has no `nextCursor`.
- **Results:** `fields` narrows a read's result to the dot paths you name. `truncated` lists the dot paths a result cut for size; the ids that fetch what was cut stay in the result.
- **Hatch:** `overflow_api_search` finds this API's operations and reads no account data, `overflow_api_details` shows one operation's contract, and `overflow_api_read` calls a reviewed read. `overflow_api_write` calls a reviewed write; the host may ask the user to confirm it. An operation without a reviewed verdict is refused. 0 operations are refused by design; use `overflow_api_details` with the method and path to inspect an operation's contract and refusal.
- **Writes:** a write is sent once and never retried. When its outcome is unknown, read the target before repeating it. Writes take no idempotency key.
- **Errors:** codes come from the vendor's statuses and error facts, never its prose. `not_found` means the record does not exist; this API tells absence from a permission gap. It documents no conflict.
- **Withheld values:** a value withheld for safety reads `"[redacted]"`. Writes refuse whole marker values and withheld links; longer prose may mention the marker. Paths and queries refuse any containment.

tools.name: list_contributions
tools.description: List gifts (cash, stock, crypto, DAF, manual) with status, amount, campaign, deposit, and donor name. Donor contact details stay in get_donor.

tools.name: overflow_api_search
tools.description: Find Overflow API operations by keyword or path. Returns up to 8 compact matches with the tool that calls each; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous search with the same query.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

matched.description: The request or response field this operation was found by; call its tool to read the field.

truncated.description: Entry labels cut for size; overflow_api_details on that method and path returns them whole.

tools.name: overflow_api_details
tools.description: Read one Overflow API operation's request contract: path, query and body parameters with types and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

param.description: Return only this parameter, in full.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous details call with the same method, path and param.

body.description: Body content type and schema. When paged: this page's properties, the required names it delivers or chunks, and the schema's other keywords on the page that carries them.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

of.description: The piece this text belongs to, such as parameters.limit.

text.description: Part of that piece's JSON; join the parts in page order, then parse them.

truncated.description: Labels cut for size; their full text arrives as chunks.

page.description: Present when the contract exceeds one answer: pass nextCursor back for the next pieces.

tools.name: overflow_api_read
tools.description: Call a reviewed Overflow API read. The operation index checks arguments before anything is sent. Paths are relative to /api/v3. Array query filters use bracketed names and repeated values; GET /health returns text.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /donors/6710f34fd5061afeec3eab50. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.

param.description: Put nextCursor in this vendor parameter, unchanged.

tools.name: overflow_api_write
tools.description: Call a reviewed Overflow API write; method and path are stated for approval, and the operation index checks arguments first. Refund acknowledgements can be JSON strings or plain text; empty write acknowledgements are valid. Resolve donor and payment-method ids first; money units differ by field.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /donors/6710f34fd5061afeec3eab50. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

body.description: Request body as JSON fields, named as details lists them; form operations are encoded for you.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data, applied to each item of an array, after value safety and privacy filtering.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.
